metadata.title: Multivate
metadata.description: Structured learning paths in tech and German language to help you study, work, and live your dream.
metadata.homeTitle: Tech and German training for study and work in Germany
metadata.homeDescription: Multivate teaches technology and German-language skills for study, work, and life in Germany. Browse courses, message mentors, and learn at your own pace.
metadata.aboutDescription: Multivate is a Nigerian training company for German language and technology skills used in study, work, and everyday life in Germany.
metadata.contactDescription: Write to Multivate at info@multivate.com.ng. Campus teaching is in Ibadan, Oyo State, with online courses for learners anywhere.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Multivate trains people in German and technology for study, work, and life in Germany. The company is based in Ibadan, Nigeria.
aboutPage.title: About Multivate
aboutPage.intro: Multivate Technological Services & Consultancy Limited teaches German and technology skills for people who want to study, work, or settle in Germany. We run online courses and campus sessions in Ibadan.
aboutPage.missionBody: We focus on language you will use in applications, workplaces, and daily life, plus the technical skills that sit next to those plans. Mentors who already live in Germany are available to answer practical questions.
aboutPage.whoBody: Students, job seekers, and working adults who need a clear path rather than a pile of unrelated lessons. Instructors publish courses through Course Studio after review.
aboutPage.whereBody: Online for anyone with an account. In-person and hybrid sessions are based in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria.

contactPage.metaDescription: Email Multivate at info@multivate.com.ng. Campus teaching is in Ibadan, Oyo State.
contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.intro: For accounts, courses, payments, and teaching, write to us. We do not list social profiles here until those channels are official.
